fields.text: It was narrated from Ayyub, from a Shailh of Qushair, from his paternal uncle; then we met him concerning some camels of his, and Bu Qilabah said to him:"Tell it to us." The old man said: "My paternal uncle told me that he went to the Prophet, concerning some camels of his, while he was eating. He said: 'Come and eat.' I said: 'I am fasting.' He said: 'Allah, the mighty and sublime, has waived half of the prayer and fasting for the traveler, the pregnant woman and the sick

fields.text: Ayyub qabeela Qushair ke ek sheikh se, aur woh Qushairi apne chacha se riwayat karte hain, (Ayyub kehte hain) humse hadees bayan ki gayi, phir humne unhein (sheikh Qushairi ko) unke oonton mein paya, toh unse Abu Qilabah ne kaha: aap inse (Ayyub se) hadees bayan kijiye toh (Qushairi) sheikh ne kaha: mujhse mere chacha ne bayan kiya ke woh apne oonton mein gaye, aur Nabi Akram (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas pahunche, Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) khana kha rahe thay (ravi ko shak hai 'ya'kul' kaha ya 'yut'im' kaha) Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: 'Qareeb aao aur khana khao' (ravi ko shak hai 'adni fakul' kaha ya 'adni fa'tim' kaha) toh maine kaha: 'Main saaim hoon'. Aap (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: 'Allah Ta'ala ne musafir ko aadhi namaz aur roze ki chhoot de di hai, aur hamila aurat aur doodh pilane wali aurat ko bhi'.
